evidence.quote: I take the liberty, at the suggestion of Dr. Royle, of forwarding to you a few seeds, which have been found under very singular circumstances. They have been sent to me by Mr. W. Kemp of Galashiels (a partially educated) man, of whose acuteness & accuracy of observation: from several communications on geological subjects, I have a very high opinion. He found them in a layer under about 25 feet thickness of white sand, which seems to have been deposited on the margin of an anciently existing lake. These seeds are not known to the provincial Botanists of the district. He states that some of them germinated in eight days after being planted, & are now alive.
